components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Teal pill CTA. Used for main actions: Get Started, form submission.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: #00BDAA; color: #011B2A; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 13px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #1AB7A0; transform: translateY(-2px); box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(0,189,170,0.2); } .ds-btn-icon { width: 24px; height: 24px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(0,27,42,0.15); display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover .ds-btn-icon { transform: translateX(3px) scale(1.05); }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined pill for secondary actions: Explore Products, Learn More.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.1); color: #F1F5F9; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; padding: 12px 24px; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #00BDAA; background: rgba(0,189,170,0.04); }

components.name: CTA Input
components.description: Email input for the CTA form section. Pill-shaped with leading envelope icon.
components.css: .ds-input-wrap { position: relative; flex: 1; } .ds-input-icon { position: absolute; left: 14px; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%); color: #64748B; } .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 12px 12px 12px 40px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03); color: #F1F5F9; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 13px; outline: none; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-input:focus { border-color: #00BDAA; }

narrative.overview: A financial system viewed through polished, precision-cut glass — where every surface carries the weight of a balance sheet and the clarity of a dashboard monitor. The Glass Ledger treats data as the primary visual material: numbers are large and confident, cards sit with deliberate thickness, and the teal accent cuts through dark backgrounds like a signal light on a trading floor. The system merges the trust signals of traditional banking with the energy of modern fintech. Dark mode is the default posture — the interface recedes so the data leads.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first with a warm-cool balance (navy + teal, not pure black + cyan)
Cards have physical presence via gradient borders and inner highlights
Motion serves state changes and narrative progression, never decoration
Typography is geometric and technical (Space Grotesk) paired with a humanist sans (Plus Jakarta Sans)
Bilingual English/Khmer with typographic accommodations for Khmer script
Rejects: side-stripe borders, gradient text, glassmorphism as default, identical card grids

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: The Neon Teal accent occupies at most 30% of any given screen. Its rarity is the point.

dos: Use the double-bezel card architecture (gradient shell + inset inner) for every card and container
Use Neon Teal as the single accent voice
Lead with dark mode and offer light mode as a toggle
Place the nav as a floating glass pill detached from the top edge
Animate with cubic-bezier(0.32, 0.72, 0, 1) — the custom curve is part of the brand's motion signature
Use Space Grotesk for all numbers and financial metrics
Respect Khmer typography with adjusted line-height and zero letter-spacing
donts: Use side-stripe borders (colored border-left/right > 1px) on cards or callouts
Use gradient text (background-clip: text) — use solid colors instead
Use glassmorphism as a default card treatment — blur belongs on the nav only
Build identical card grids with icon + heading + text repeated endlessly
Put tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow badges above every section
Use numbered section markers (01 / 02 / 03) as default scaffolding
Nest cards inside other cards — never deeper than one level
Use Inter, Roboto, or system fonts
